# graviteeam_bot_detection (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Bot Detection plugin

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_bot_detection" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name      = "reCAPTCHA v3"
  type      = "google-recaptcha-v3-am-bot-detection"
  configuration = jsonencode({
    siteKey   = "6Le..."
    secretKey = "6Le..."
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String) JSON configuration for the bot detection plugin
- `detection_type` (String) The detection type
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `name` (String) The name of the bot detection
- `type` (String) The bot detection plugin type

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the bot detection
